title: Coach v9 Risk Score
description: Per-phase-exit risk-score document. Producer: coach risk-scorer (#M3). Consumer: PR routing, review reporters (#N2), gate auto-phase. Single-doc JSON, written to `.atdd/runtime/validations/<sha>/risk-score.json` and rewritten on every phase exit (not append-only). Spec: atdd-coach-spec-v9.md §6.8 / §C0.

sum.description: Total risk = sum of severity * count across all unsuppressed validator-results for this <sha>.

by_severity.description: Risk slice keyed by severity level (1..5). Keys are stringified integers because JSON object keys are strings.

by_archetype.description: Risk slice keyed by archetype name. MUST include the `repo` slice (per spec §C0); other archetypes (`db`, `be`, `fe`, `coach`, `contracts`, …) appear when they contributed risk for this run.

by_disposition.description: Risk slice keyed by disposition. Values mirror the substrate disposition vocabulary.

stale_suppressions.description: Count of suppression markers whose `UNTIL=<date>` is in the past. Risk-score sum does NOT include these (suppressed results are excluded from sum); the count is exposed separately so the gate can fail on staleness.

phase.description: Optional ATDD phase this risk score was emitted at the exit of.

generated_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the risk-score doc was rewritten.

sha.description: Optional commit SHA the risk score is anchored on (mirrors the directory anchor `validations/<sha>/`).
